title: asperula sherardia var. maritima
intro: Asperula sherardia var. maritima, commonly known as Sea Wood Sorrel, is a subspecies of the Asperula sherardia plant, which belongs to the Rubiaceae family. It is a perennial herb native to the coastal regions of Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Sea Wood Sorrel include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant activities.
